Frontier model usage & on-prem sizing

1. Get the usage from the customer

An admin pastes this prompt into their analytics chat and sends you the answer. Use one prompt per provider.


        
        
      


      

        
2. Add the answers

        
Paste what the chat returned, or drop the .csv files here, including the CSVs claude.ai's
          analytics chat lets you download (drop all of them; overlapping ones aren't double-counted) and Claude
          Console usage exports. Add as many providers as you like.

        
        

          
          
        

        

        

      


      

        
3. Build the report

        
Opens the Usage, On-prem sizing and Grafana tabs. You can come back here to add more data
          and rebuild.

        

          
          
        

        
Everything runs in this browser. The customer's data isn't uploaded anywhere.

    Put this report in Grafana
    
        
    The dashboard carries its own data, so nothing else needs to be set up besides the free Infinity plugin.
    
        
    Easiest: in the Frontier Usage app, fill in your Grafana address and a service-account token under
          "Grafana" and click Publish to Grafana. It creates or updates this dashboard for you.
    
        
    Or import it by hand:
    
        
      
          
    1. 
            (also saved next to this report as grafana-dashboard.json)
      2. 
          
    2. Make sure the Infinity data source plugin is installed: Administration → Plugins, search "Infinity"
            (Grafana Cloud has it), or on the server: grafana-cli plugins install yesoreyeram-infinity-datasource
      3. 
          
    3. Add an Infinity data source if you don't have one: Connections → Data sources → Add → Infinity, then Save.
      4. 
          
    4. Dashboards → New → Import, upload the JSON, pick the Infinity data source, and click Import.
      5. 
        
    
        
    Each report makes a fresh snapshot. Re-importing (or re-publishing) replaces the dashboard with the same name.
